delta.comment: Staging-readiness remediation (2026-08-19, P1 Markdown gate). Applied the repository-established scoped suppression `<!-- markdownlint-disable-next-line MD025 -->` before the body H1 to resolve the frontmatter-title/body-H1 conflict. Also corrected three lists that were not preceded by a blank line (so did not render as lists) and wrapped `git cat-file -p :<path> | sha256` in a code span, since the bare `<path>` was parsed as inline HTML and vanished on render. Deliberation content is otherwise unchanged; backlogit doctor validates the artifact as pass.

Stage fix cycle 2 (2026-08-19, P1 coherence). Normative-content clause 3 was amended in place: the reference obligation is now conditional on actual thread availability rather than requiring a review-thread reply unconditionally, which was unsatisfiable for pre-PR local-review and build/CI findings. A dated C3 AMENDMENT annotation was appended to the Notes section so the decision record shows the change rather than being silently rewritten. The deliberated decision (Option C -- new named policy P-021 carried across all coherent surfaces) is unchanged, as are clauses 1, 2 and 4-7. The operator's verbatim direction in the frontmatter and problem frame was NOT altered.
